summary: Keep per-quote source and date aligned with the snapshot that supplies its price, ignore older live rows, and mark top-level metadata mixed when prices use different snapshots.
reason: An automatic live-fetch fallback may return a stored snapshot; overlaying its older price while labeling it with the screener's newer source and date misrepresents both the value and its freshness.
validated_outcome: Tests verify older live snapshots are excluded, newer live prices are used, and selected source/date metadata follows the chosen price snapshot.
